facts.fact: The World Bank's Digital Eswatini concept-stage PID states Eswatini residents paid on average 3.4 per cent of GNI per capita per month for the cheapest 2 GB of mobile broadband data, above the 2 per cent global benchmark; this is the 2 GB basket, no date given so the document's published date is used.
